verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a security review, scan, or audit of generated apps before publishing. The testing agent runs browser-based functional tests of user flows, and automatic SSL covers transport security; both are adjacent features, not a pre-launch security review. The community report concerns a vulnerability in Base44's own platform endpoints and says nothing about whether apps get reviewed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live
